children: The FTSE‑100 firm added that further earn‑out payments of up to $30m may be made depending on Pyxis’ performance over the next two financial years.
Pyxis designs sensors and systems used across industrial, municipal and environmental applications, and will operate as a standalone business within Halma’s Environmental & Analysis division.
Reporting by Frank Prenesti for Sharecast.com
